budget.rationale: The seven reconciled categories total $6,200–$9,630, below the shared $12,000 target. Exact June 2027 airfare, rooms and tours are not quoted, so the score remains medium-confidence.

weather.rationale: June is hot with warm water, but humidity, showers, thunderstorms and early Atlantic hurricane-season exposure require flexible days and refundable bookings.

swim.rationale: Low-80s°F June water, five Luquillo nights, a pool requirement and an Icacos day create the strongest warm-swimming access in the short-trip set, conditional on live flags and storms.

variety.rationale: The compact route combines a fortified colonial city, family beach, tropical rainforest, catamaran/reef day and genuine rest time without adding a third base.

ease.rationale: Domestic travel, one expected connection, one hotel move and short northeast-coast drives are unusually easy. The flight connection and five-day rental keep this below 5.

food.rationale: San Juan and Luquillo both have pizza, burgers, chicken, fries, supermarkets and a five-night kitchen fallback; exact 2027 menus and hours require recheck.

risk.rationale: The ground plan is simple, but tropical systems, rip currents, thunderstorms, forest closures and boat cancellations remain meaningful managed risks.

nights.rationale: Seven hotel nights deliberately optimize ease and PTO, but the shared rubric gives trips of eight nights or fewer 1/5.

novelty.rationale: Puerto Rico is absent from the family visited-place record, so the destination and tropical-city/rainforest combination are new.

pto.rationale: Saturday-to-Saturday travel plus Juneteenth observed on Friday June 18 requires only four PTO weekdays.
